description: Page listNotifications and listMemberNotificationSettings by cursor. Each operation takes `cursor` and `limit` query parameters and answers { status, requestId, result: [...], limit, nextCursor } (the spec describes nextCursor as 'Cursor for the next page, to be sent as the `cursor` query parameter. Null on the last page.'). The converter's cursor detection does not recognise `nextCursor`, so the list was a single-page call. Observed live 2026-11-12: GET .../notifications with limit=1 answered 200 with one item and no next page (request id bb8f94ee-336b-4a66-b6b9-2af1df4ab507); GET .../members/{userId}/notificationSettings answered 200 with an empty result (0ecf78ac-094a-4419-b31e-a1e6f202146d). The multi-page traversal was captured on listApiKeys, which answers the same envelope.
